description: Rubric bank for Conflict_Dojo feedback. Rubrics are LENSES, not verdicts: every dimension anchors to utterance-level evidence; scores are directional practice signals. conf_deescalation_v2 EXTENDS the ConvoDojo conflict_deescalation_v1 rubric (Phase 3 skeleton) with arousal recognition and repair-after-miss; conf_interest_based_v1 covers the positions-vs-interests / reframing / option-generation arc. Auto-coded scores are lenses, never final (Han 2026, VERIFIED: ~52.6% automatic MI coding ceiling analog).

extends.note: keeps all base dimensions; adds arousal recognition and repair-after-miss

dimensions.metric: reflection quality at high pressure levels (complex reflections that name the feeling beneath the heat)
dimensions.note: Aimi/Shenoi 2026 (VERIFIED): complex-reflection fidelity transfers to de-escalation turns

dimensions.metric: explicit agenda offers that include the other's concerns first
offers to pause/regroup offered as choices, not withdrawals
no retaliatory escalation into the conflict (matching heat, arguing substance, rebutting feelings)
learner names the other's state/emotion without shaming ('it sounds like this feels like being overruled again')
dimensions.note: RECONSTRUCTED dimension from practice evidence (affect labeling as de-escalation mechanism)

dimensions.metric: after an escalation or misstep, the learner repairs (acknowledges, re-reflects) without groveling or over-apologizing
dimensions.note: repair is a rubric dimension, not a failure — the no_shaming gate holds the stage until repair happens

rubrics.target: positions-vs-interests, reframing, and option generation in conflict

extends.note: companion rubric to conf_deescalation_v2; covers the post-de-escalation arc

dimensions.metric: learner treats the stated position as data and elicits the interests beneath it (what does the position protect?)
dimensions.note: Fisher & Ury (canonical anchor, not fetched this campaign; RECONSTRUCTED applicability): positions are data, interests are the raw material of resolution

dimensions.metric: position restated as interest + shared ground named, in the persona's language where possible
reframes offered as hypotheses the persona may confirm or correct; corrections treated as success
dimensions.note: a reframe that overwrites the other's account is a named miss (mirrors MI reflection-as-hypothesis discipline)

dimensions.metric: options generated jointly, >= 2, without commitment extraction
criteria elicited from the persona BEFORE options are weighed
no forcing of agreement; unresolved options accepted as a valid outcome
dimensions.note: halt states are designed, not defects (Valens corpus law; empowerment_boundary.md prohibition 7 analog)

rubrics.target: keeping the conversation human while it stays hard

extends.note: observational companion rubric; safety is the top invariant (EasyMED 2025, VERIFIED)

dimensions.metric: learner validates the persona's experience without endorsing the position or shaming the person
zero turns attacking the persona's identity/character (hard count; one occurrence = developing, stage holds per no_shaming gate)
learner names emotions accurately and gently ('frustrated', 'unheard') without diagnosing the persona
silences and pauses allowed; the learner does not fill every beat with words
learner manages their own escalation (does not match hot affect, does not take the bait)
dimensions.note: RECONSTRUCTED dimension: self-regulation under pressure is the transfer target of stress levels 4-5

rubric_use_rules: rubrics are lenses: scores anchor to quotes, never standalone
no rubric score becomes a verdict about the user as a person
the no_shaming gate runs BEFORE feedback on any flagged turn (hard gate, not a dimension to negotiate)
de-escalation dimensions are scored before interest-based dimensions; a hot session scores the former only
debrief template (debrief_template.md) consumes rubric output with evidence sections
